title: Create domain
description: Create a new domain (sub-system): a named group of related entities in this workspace. Call this before create_entity when starting a new business area. Does not create entities.

name.description: Name of the sub-system. Unique per tenant, case-insensitive. Example: Academics.

description.description: Optional short description of what this sub-system covers.

color.description: Accent colour for the sub-system in the workspace. Defaults to slate when omitted.

x-enum-descriptions.slate: Neutral grey accent. Used when colour is omitted.
